name: St Teresa of Avila and St Joseph, Irlam
shortName: St Teresa of Avila and St Joseph

boundary.description: From the point where Wigan – Salford District boundary crosses the railway, E along the railway, then S along the footpath going past Manor Farm and Bartonmoss Farm, crossing M62 Motorway, continuing in a straight line to the SW border of Boysnope Park Golf Club. Along that border and by a bee-line to Manchester Ship Canal (Salford – Trafford District boundary). Then N along Warrington – Salford District boundary and E along Wigan – Salford District boundary to the point where it crosses the railway.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St Teresa and St Joseph
internalBoundaries.description: From the point opposite Fairhills Road, W along Fairhills Road, Roscoe Road, Astley Road to the Wigan – Salford District boundary.
